snippet_primary: "Gumroad does not assess or collect "listing" or "insertion" fees, but will collect the Gumroad Fee from buyer proceeds as described in section 6.4. The Gumroad Fees vary depending on whether a Product is resold on the Website or on the applicable Supplier Property that leverages the Services. The current Gumroad Fees can be viewed on the page "Pricing". We may change the Gumroad Fees from time to time by posting the changes on the Website."
